Deployed output-metric adaptation:
Source revision: 75c22a2a98d3b16a1c298735e2ea385cccfd07fb
Source files: explainability/model.py (output_metric classifier component),
explainability/nmf_fit.py (tile_uniform, metric_sample, metric_transform).
The numerical bodies listed above were independently checked as identical at
this deployed revision; their original provenance constant is retained for
legacy plain artifacts. ml/concept_explainability/metric.py reuses the classifier
outer-product/variance, trace normalization, ridge/eigh and hash-threshold
sampling algebra. Native adapter: native_mean_linear_binary_classifier_v1.
Native binary logits are represented as [0,z] before class centering. MeanPool
has no attention output, so its inapplicable attention term is explicitly omitted
and recorded; this is not the unchanged UC attention graph. Validation and
artifact/source binding checks are MammaPrint integration code.

Deployed gallery run: b30054c6bffb4df8896c8acb75a48959
